target.title: fix(discord): skip italics rebalance prepend for code fence and inline code chunks
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #102911 — when `rebalanceReasoningItalics` reopens italics on the next chunk after a split, it unconditionally prepends `_` without checking if the chunk opens with a code fence or inline code backtick. This produces `_``` or _` which breaks Discord markdown rendering.

## Why This Change Was Made

Guard the `_` prepend with `!nextBody.startsWith("\`")` so code fences and inline code at chunk boundaries are preserved.

A single backtick check covers triple fences, quad fences, and inline code — all start with `` ` ``.

## User Impact

Discord reasoning output containing code blocks no longer has broken fences when the message is chunked across a code fence boundary.

## Evidence

### Tests

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/chunk.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  19 passed (19)
```

### Regression verification

Running main code with the corrected fixtures proves the tests catch the bug:

```
main:
  x does not prepend italics underscore to start of chunk when it opens with code fence
     Received: "_```python\n..."
  x does not prepend italics underscore to start of chunk when it opens with inline code
     Received: "_`inline code`..."

fix:
  19 passed (19)
```

### Production-path proof

The fixed guard correctly preserves a code fence at the chunk boundary:

```
$ node --import tsx <proof-script>
chunk 0 starts: "Reasoning:"
chunk 1 starts: "```python"
codeFenceBroken=false
result=PASS
```

### Files Changed (2 files, +59/-1)

```
 extensions/discord/src/chunk.ts      |  2 +-
 extensions/discord/src/chunk.test.ts | 59 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
```
